dedupe_keys.name: data from study on modular smoke extraction with solid screen in urban road tunnel fires

description: Xiaotao Zhang publishes a freely downloadable ZIP of CFD configuration, code and processed outputs for modular road-tunnel smoke extraction under CC BY 4.0. The December 2025 deposit names the same study subsequently published in PLOS One in February 2026. The paper describes FDS simulations of a generic straight, horizontal tunnel 400 metres long and ten by six metres in cross-section, evaluated over 600 seconds. Screen heights, modular zones and exhaust allocation are varied. These materials can compare ventilation assumptions in tunnel-fire simulations. Open portals, constant fire output and omitted external or vehicle-driven airflow limit transfer to operating tunnels. Related catalogue record model-nist-fds-smokeview describes the solver. The paper’s availability statement refers to its own supporting files and does not independently confirm archive equivalence. File completeness and numerical uncertainty remain unverified; nothing was downloaded or run.
